description: This file contains functions for processing media attachments within a messaging context, including formatting media lines, detecting audio file paths, and building media notes based on message context.

methods.name: formatMediaAttachedLine
methods.description: Formats a media attachment line with optional type and URL information.

methods.name: isAudioPath
methods.description: Checks if a given file path has an audio file extension.

methods.name: buildInboundMediaNote
methods.description: Builds a media note string based on the message context, including handling of suppressed and transcribed audio attachments.
